name: GL_LEDGERS
description: GL_LEDGERS contains information about the ledgers defined in the Accounting Setup Manager and the ledger sets defined in the Ledger Set form.  Each row includes the ledger or ledger set name, short name, description, ledger currency, calendar, period type, chart of accounts, and other information. Some columns in this table are not applicable for ledger sets.  In this case, default values would be inserted into these columns for ledger sets.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique ledger identifier.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: User entered unique ledger name.

columns.name: SHORT_NAME
columns.description: User entered unique ledger short name.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the ledger definition.

columns.name: LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Type of ledger. Valid values are PRIMARY, SECONDARY and ALC.

columns.name: ALC_LEDGER_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Ledger type (ledger or ledger set).

columns.name: LE_LEDGER_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: COMPLETION_STATUS_CODE

columns.name: CONFIGURATION_ID

columns.description: Subledger cash basis accounting flag.

columns.description: Ledger configuration completion status flag.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USSGL_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Journal import validates USSGL transaction codes when this value is 'Yes'.

columns.name: VALIDATE_JOURNAL_REF_DATE
columns.description: Journal reference date will be validated to ensure the date falls into an open or future enterable period.

columns.name: JRNLS_GROUP_BY_DATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates how journal import will group journal lines by accounting date.

columns.name: REVAL_FROM_PRI_LGR_CURR
columns.description: Indicates which currency to use when creating revaluation entries for the additional ledger currency.

columns.name: AUTOREV_AFTER_OPEN_PRD_FLAG
columns.description: General Ledger automatically submits the AutoReverse program when a new period is first opened when this flag is enabled.

columns.name: PRIOR_PRD_NOTIFICATION_FLAG
columns.description: When this flag is enabled, Oracle Fusion General Ledger notifies a user when a journal is entered for a prior period.

columns.name: POP_UP_STAT_ACCOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: If this flag is enabled, then users can enter statistical amounts along with monetary amounts in the Enter Journals window.

columns.name: THRESHOLD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Threshold amount allows to create an additional balancing journal line if accounted debit and accounted credit offset is more than a certain amount.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS
columns.description: Used by Subledger Accounting to indicate the number of processors.

columns.name: PROCESSING_UNIT_SIZE
columns.description: Used by Subledger Accounting to indicate the processing unit size.

columns.name: RELEASE_UPGRADE_FROM
columns.description: Indicates the release that the ledger is upgraded from.

columns.name: CROSS_LGR_CLR_ACC_CCID
columns.description: Cross ledger clearing account combination identifier.

columns.name: INTERCO_GAIN_LOSS_CCID
columns.description: Intercompany gain loss code  combination identifier.

columns.name: SEQUENCING_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Sequencing Code to identify the level of Sequencing. Valid values are - No Sequencing, Ledger level Sequencing and Legal Entity level Sequencing.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCING_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Document Sequencing Option. Valid values are - General Ledger, Payables and Receivables.

columns.name: ENF_SEQ_DATE_CORRELATION_CODE
columns.description: Option to enforce correlation between sequence date and subledger trasaction sequence number for subledger transactions.

columns.name: AR_DOC_SEQUENCING_OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Document sequencing option enforced for receivables.

columns.name: AP_DOC_SEQUENCING_OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Document sequencing option enforced for payables.

columns.name: NET_CLOSING_BAL_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether Closing Journals programs will create net closing journal entries or accumulated closing journal entries.

columns.name: AUTOMATE_SEC_JRNL_REV_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether a replicated secondary ledger journal can be reversed or not when the parent primary ledger journal is reversed.

columns.name: MINIMUM_THRESHOLD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum threshold used to determine whether the difference between accounted debits and accounted credits is a rounding error or a balancing issue. The actual threshold used may be larger.

columns.name: STRICT_PERIOD_CLOSE_FLAG
columns.description: STRICT_PERIOD_CLOSE_FLAG is used to determine for given period whether the period close process should error out if period in certain set of subledgers is not yet closed or any unprocessed/partly processed transactions lying in both subledgers and general ledger.

columns.name: INCOME_STMT_ADB_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of maintaining average balances for income statement accounts. Some possible values are ENABLED and DISABLED.

columns.name: BALANCE_MJE_BY_CURRENCY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to require manually created journals are balanced by currency.

columns.name: SINGLE_CURRENCY_JOURNAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to limit a journal to a single currency.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information for this ledger which when combined with the journal or balance period, determines the database partition in which journals or balances for this ledger are stored.

columns.name: POSTING_CUTOFF_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to limit posting to journals with accounting dates on or before the cutoff date. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: POSTING_CUTOFF_DATE
columns.description: Date that accounting date on each journal is evaluated against to determine posting eligibility. Journals with accounting dates on or before the specified cutoff are eligible for posting.

columns.name: POSTING_CUTOFF_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Time zone used to derive the cutoff date that the accounting date on each journal is evaluated against to determine whether a journal is eligible for posting.

columns.name: LEDGER_SET_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification of a ledger set. Valid values are ORA_GL_CURRENCY_SPECIFIC for ledger sets with a specific currency and ORA_GL_GAAP_VIEW for ledger sets with a full accounting view.

columns.name: LEDGER_SET_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency associated with the ledger set.
